title: consistent screen title margins
description:
Owner finding 2026-11-12: the four browse screens' titles still sat at
different left edges even after E4's hoist made Library's vertical chain
identical. The remaining delta was horizontal: Projects, Exports and
Settings wrapped their whole screen (title included) in a root Column
with padding(horizontal = 16dp), which stacked with ScreenHeader's own
start = 16dp — their titles sat 32dp from the screen edge while
Library's sat 16dp.

Fix: the root Column of every browse screen pads NOTHING; ScreenHeader
owns the title's entire margin. The 16dp screen gutter (DESIGN.md
Layout) moved into each screen's body container below the header, so
all content keeps its exact margins: Projects' centered empty state,
Exports' job cards + empty state, Settings' rows + segmented picker +
report list + version footer.

ScreenHeader's doc now states the call-site contract (root Column
unpadded, no nested
